prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Liu Bei from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the benevolent founder of Shu Han, who swore sisterhood in the Peach Garden. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

World (fixed): year 2190, the Shu frontier colony on a jade-green moon: terraced garden cities under vast glass domes, a ringed gas giant filling the sky, an orbital elevator climbing into space, starship docks glowing green. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Weapon (fixed — ours): a pair of matched twin swords in one double scabbard, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour and no wood, silk tassels or forged-bronze fittings.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): warm chestnut-brown hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): warm beige skin. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Rank (fixed): she is a ruler — her costume must read her sovereign rank at first glance: layered, richly ornate and regal, with flagship-card detail, fine engraving and jewellery, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Chosen costume silhouette: a long coat made of rigid plates from the shoulders to below the knees, open at the front to show the body armor, with an angular collar.
Costume construction: The long sovereign command coat is entirely articulated hard-surface armor. Its rigid lappets are assembled from crossing ladder-like alloy ribs recalling a straw sandal's humble woven construction, each rib physically interlocked into an elaborate protective lattice. Thick jade-green and white-jade plates, imperial-gold engraved edges, earthen-brown composite joints and warm green emitters. Tall angular crown antenna and jeweled sensor earrings. Deep chest opening, bare waist, fully plated legs and arms, imposing layered command regalia, no cloth.

Character, pose and scene: A small softly oval face with broad soft cheeks, a short midface and small chin, naturally open honey-green eyes, level soft brows, a refined straight nose and rounded rose lips, warm beige skin. Warm chestnut-brown hair in a shoulder-length wavy bob with a tucked side part. Delicate rose makeup and a gentle thoughtful expression. She pivots slightly toward the viewer on a glass-domed garden-city platform with both feet visibly planted, holding the intact double scabbard with both hands horizontally below the waist. Futuristic terraces, green-lit starship docks and a gas giant rising beyond the dome at twilight.

One adult woman only, one head, two naturally joined arms and two legs; both hands visible with five natural fingers each. Far-future setting only; no traditional East-Asian architecture, pagodas, tiled roofs or hanzi. No text, logo, watermark or border.
